people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
translations.bsb: So John called two of his disciples and sent them to ask the Lord, “Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?”
translations.kjv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?
translations.asv: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to the Lord, saying, Art thou he that cometh, or look we for another?
